info.title: PharmaCart synthetic API
info.description: Local B0-B3 backend. Cash EGP tax-exempt fixtures only; no real suppliers.

code.description: Extensible refusal code. Boundary and tenant codes are upper case (INVALID_REQUEST, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_SCOPE_CONFLICT); an inventory refusal forwards the domain rejection reason verbatim in lower case (stale_sequence, conflicting_partition), so the code is deliberately not enumerated.

message.description: Fixed redacted sentence. It never echoes request values or internal detail.

HealthStatus.description: Liveness of the process only. It reports no dependency, database or version detail.

OpenapiDocument.description: The generated document served by this endpoint, byte for byte the packaged packages/contracts/openapi.json.

TenantContext.description: Scope resolved for this request from the verified token subject and the requested organisation and branch headers. It carries no token, no credential and no other membership.

principalKind.description: Only member principals reach the tenant routes; service principals are not implemented.

organisationKind.description: Purchasing and receipt routes additionally require a pharmacy organisation.

allowedBranchIds.description: Exactly the requested branch: one transaction never widens beyond the branch its row level security policy is set to.

role.description: Active membership role. Quoting and approval require pharmacy_owner or purchaser; receipts require pharmacy_owner or receiver.

membershipVersion.description: Version of the active membership row used for this request.

NeedView.description: Single need in the requested branch. A need outside the scope is indistinguishable from a missing one.

productRef.description: Source product reference carried from the inventory target.

quantity.description: Stored requested_quantity as numeric text. It is the outstanding remainder while the status is open, and the frozen final tranche once the status is covered.

version.description: Incremented whenever an approval settles part of the need, which invalidates an earlier quote.

InventoryAcceptance.description: Durable outcome of one snapshot event. The inbox write, projection and derived needs are committed before this acknowledgement; a rejected event is refused with an error envelope instead.

eventId.description: Event identifier echoed from the validated command.

duplicate.description: True when the event was already recorded and nothing changed.

projectionRevision.description: Revision of the installation projection after the event; 0 before any partition has been completed.

Quote.description: Binding synthetic quote. Creation is all or nothing: a line without a verified mapping or a binding offer refuses the request with 422 rather than returning a partial quote.

version.description: Creation always returns version 1; the stored quote version is never incremented.

currency.description: The quote table constrains the currency to EGP for the synthetic fixtures.

expiresAt.description: UTC instant, the earlier of the five minute quote lifetime and the earliest offer expiry.

pricingRuleVersion.description: Synthetic cash, tax-exempt pricing rule. It is a fixture identifier, not a configured commercial policy: discount, tax and fees are always zero and no mapping administration or supplier selection policy is applied.

termsHash.description: SHA-256 digest over the quoted lines.

needVersion.description: Need version the binding price was taken against.

quantity.description: Quantity echoed from the validated request, so it stays canonical and positive.

unit.description: Requested sale unit, equal to the identity sale unit.

identity.description: Catalogue identity snapshot copied from the verified procurement product. Only saleUnit is contractual: a line whose requested unit differs is refused with 422 UNIT_MISMATCH. Further catalogue attributes may be present and are passed through unchanged.

offerVersion.description: Account offer version the price came from.

termsVersion.description: Supplier relationship terms version, equal on the offer and the relationship.

discount.description: Line discount. The synthetic cash tax-exempt rule always emits '0'.

tax.description: Line tax. The synthetic cash tax-exempt rule always emits '0'.

fees.description: Line fees. The synthetic cash tax-exempt rule always emits '0'.

net.description: Payable line amount, equal to gross under the synthetic rule.

unmetLines.description: Always empty. An unsatisfiable line refuses the whole quote, so unmet demand is never reported here.

total.description: Sum of the line net amounts, rounded to two decimals by the database.

ApprovalResult.description: Result of approving a quote. 202 records a new approval, budget reservation and one order intent per supplier; 200 reports an already approved quote under a new idempotency key. An identical key replays its original status and body, including 202. Both statuses carry this shape.

quoteVersion.description: Quote version echoed from the validated command.

status.description: Submission is queued through the transactional outbox; no supplier has been contacted at this point.

orderIntentIds.description: One intent per distinct supplier in the quote, in ascending supplier order.

OrderDetail.description: Order intent in the requested branch with its supplier settled quantities.

externalClientRef.description: Stable client reference used for every submission and lookup of this intent; it survives a restore.

externalOrderId.description: Supplier order identity. Null until an acknowledgement is recorded, and never replaced afterwards.

version.description: Intent version, incremented by every state transition.

productIdentity.description: Catalogue identity snapshot copied from the verified procurement product. Only saleUnit is contractual: a line whose requested unit differs is refused with 422 UNIT_MISMATCH. Further catalogue attributes may be present and are passed through unchanged.

ordered.description: Quantity ordered from the supplier for this line.

accepted.description: Supplier accepted quantity; '0' until an acknowledgement settles the line.

rejected.description: Supplier rejected quantity; accepted plus rejected never exceeds ordered.

shipped.description: Supplier shipped quantity; never greater than accepted.

received.description: Confirmed received quantity; never greater than shipped. Receipts add to it, so the reading keeps the widest scale of the amounts summed.

lines.description: Empty until the worker materialises the lines when it claims the intent for submission.

uncertainty.description: Present while the state is submitting, outcome_unknown or human_review, and null otherwise. An uncertain outcome is never reported as safe to retry.

ReceiptAcknowledgement.description: Identity of the stored receipt. Repeating the same reference and lines returns the same identity; the same reference with different lines is refused with 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.

200.description: Resolved membership scope for the request
The requested need inside the resolved scope

post.description: Installation scope derives from the verified subject. Durable processing completes before acknowledgement.

200.description: Already approved quote under a new idempotency key

202.description: Approval recorded and supplier submission queued

200.description: The requested order intent inside the resolved scope
Receipt recorded and queued for writeback
